custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit and See Financial Data but without Part Library & Inventory — Delete, so user B can create and edit parts but cannot delete them.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user B, so both users' screens can be seen side by side.
  • Create an untracked part, part A, for this test, with Sell Price $15.00 and 4 in one bin location, bin location A.
  • Use a new description, description 2, that no part uses.
  • Start window 2 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425653-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425653-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • To create a custom role: Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role; in Choose a template click Skip; type the Role Name; switch on Parts Department, then tick the boxes the setup names on its three rows, Part sales, Part Library and Inventory, and Vendor and order management (each has View, Create & Edit and Delete); See Financial Data is under Cross-Cutting Toggles; then click Create. (The setup above writes these boxes as, for example, Part Library & Inventory — View, which is the View box on the Part Library and Inventory row.)
  • User B: the QA site's sign-in screen offers only Admin and Tech, so user B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B for this test. Signed in as Admin: Settings, then Staff in the left menu; click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick role B under Role and click Save & Close. Then, in the second (private) window, choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished, set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way, because other testers use that sign-in.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A for user B, with the tracking switch off.

Step 2:

  • Sell Price reads $18.00.

Step 3:

  • Bin location A's Quantity reads 6.

Step 4:

  • Description reads description 2.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and saves with no access error: editing other fields of an untracked part needs the same access as on a tracked part.
  • Part A's row shows description 2, Sell Price $18.00, bin location A with 6, and still "Not Tracked".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-N1a: “Editing any other field of a part that is already untracked, such as its price, bins or description, needs the same access as editing a tracked part today.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.6 Branch: a new part with tracking off". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-06-p1-6-untracked.png

The design's own words:

  • “With the switch off, Min and Max are hidden (S4-R5). The bin location section stays visible and is optional, so a bin can be set as a shelf reference (S4-R6). Creating a part with tracking off needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission (S8-R7). Editing other fields of a part that is already untracked needs the same access as editing a tracked part (S8-N1a).”
